邀请ID。

您可以调用[ListHandshakesForAccount](~~ListHandshakesForAccount~~)获取邀请ID。
description.en:
The ID of the invitation.

You can call the [ListHandshakesForAccount](~~ListHandshakesForAccount~~) operation to obtain the ID.

descriptions.zh: 被邀请的阿里云账号成功加入资源目录后，会成为资源目录的成员。资源目录默认使用被邀请的阿里云账号名称作为该成员的成员名称和账号名称。
descriptions.en: After an invited Alibaba Cloud account joins a resource directory, it becomes a member of the resource directory. By default, the name of the invited Alibaba Cloud account is used as the display name of the account in the resource directory.
